subject.title: feat(feishu): embed image media in card sends

question: Should this PR be narrowed to action-level card plus one media item, or must it implement the linked issue's agent-facing sendPayload path with multiple image attachments before merge?
rationale: The code change is plausible for a smaller action feature, but it does not satisfy the linked feature issue that it would close, and the linked issue already carries a maintainer-product-decision signal for Feishu trigger and fallback semantics.

options.title: Require payload-path coverage
options.body: Ask the contributor to move the core behavior into Feishu outbound sendPayload, cover multiple image attachments, and keep the linked issue open until that path is proven.

options.title: Accept as narrow action support
options.body: Retarget the PR as a smaller action-only feature, remove the closing relationship to the linked issue, and track payload/multiple-image support separately.

options.title: Pause for plugin-owner design
options.body: Hold the PR until the Feishu owner chooses automatic versus opt-in image-card behavior and fallback policy.

recommendation.title: Require payload-path coverage
recommendation.body: Ask the contributor to move the core behavior into Feishu outbound sendPayload, cover multiple image attachments, and keep the linked issue open until that path is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: m1heng is declared as the Feishu/Lark plugin owner in package metadata and is the best available owner for Feishu-specific send semantics.
